text_block_list.text:
Gold City wasn't feeling well, so I 
decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm gonna rest a bit. Let me just 
set an alarm... and there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That roller coaster was insane! I 
haven't screamed like that in ages!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Welcome ba~ck! Please continue to enjoy 
your time at this dream amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What should we do next? The teacups, the 
pirate adventure...

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
I highly recommend a gourmet food tour! 
Please take a look at the brochure!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! That might be good too—

(Creep, creep, creep, creep, creep, creep, 
creep, creep, creep, creep, creep, creep, 
creep, creep!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, so loud! What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Is that the same sound as the alarm 
clock...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh right, I have to get home!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
The parade will be starting shortly! Why 
not stay and enjoy yourself a little 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this place was definitely fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that alone won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Because... I have to run there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, 'I have to run,' huh? Yeah, 
you're right. Alright!"

Gold City made a full recovery and 
returned to training.

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text: "We sincerely apologize to our guests."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"The alert heard earlier was sounded by 
maintenance staff for an operational 
check. We apologize for any inconvenience 
caused to our guests—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, is that so... Well then, let's head 
to the next attraction."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you straight-up overslept!

"Having drastically overslept past the 
scheduled time, Gold City looked full of 
regret."
